spec.assertion: trigger is a RECURRING hitCount:40 counting ROUNDS/hits (hitsPerShot 2 → ~20 pulls), self-targeted. Fails under nearest-wrong A (once-per-battle unlock: buffApply count would be 1, assertion demands >3) and under nearest-wrong B (counting trigger PULLS not hits: the count:80 counterfactual fires strictly fewer times, proving threshold-sensitivity).

buffApply stat attackSpeedPct value 7.26, targetSlug soline, casterIdx = soline, expiresFrame set and durationShots absent. Fails under a ROUND-count reading of the duration (durationShots would be set) and under a team-scoped reading (no ally ever receives it). Also asserted NON-INERT: attack speed gates shots fired, so stripping it strictly lowers her total.

spec.kitLine: Only affects self at Max HP
spec.assertion: at scope lock v1 has no HP pool (immortal boss, nobody takes damage), so the Max-HP condition is trivially satisfied for the whole fight — the buffs must be LIVE, not gated off. Fails under a model that gates them behind an unsatisfiable/never-evaluated HP check (buff arrays would be empty). Non-vacuity paired with a strip-counterfactual that must lower her total.

UNSCOPED critRatePct (the text is plain 'Critical Rate', not 'Critical Rate of normal attacks'), self, applied once as a passive. Fails under the nearest-wrong critRateNormalPct encoding — asserted two ways: (a) soline sources ZERO critRateNormalPct events, (b) the stat-swap counterfactual moves her total, proving the two keys are not interchangeable here.

critDamagePct value 62.27, self, permanent (no re-application on a timer). Fails under a timed/stacking reading (repeat applications) and under an ally-scoped reading (teammate totals asserted byte-identical when soline's crit buffs are stripped).

one flatDamage rider of 396% per burst CAST (burstCast trigger, not fullBurstEnter — it is a damage line inside her own burst block). Paired with the 924% line: rider count must equal 2 × burstCast count, failing under a merged-single-1320% model.

spec.kitLine: same target(s) when at Max HP
spec.assertion: the 924% is a SECOND, separately-observable hit on the same cast, Max-HP-satisfied at scope lock. Magnitude ratio large/small ≈ 924/396 = 7:3 at equal buff snapshot; dropping the 924 effect leaves exactly one rider per cast and a strictly lower total. Fails under merge, under omission, and under a magnitude transposition.

FB-exempt by timing (fbMajorApplied falsy on every rider — burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens, a pinned verified fact), noRange (rangeApplied falsy — riders never take the +30% range bonus), and NO core (kit carries no 'core strike' wording). Fails under a fullBurstEnter re-key (+50% major would apply), under a range-eligible rider, and under a core-tagged rider.
enemy-facing only — soline emits ZERO buffApply/heal/shield toward any ally across the whole fight. Fails under any model that leaks a team buff out of the burst block.

cross-line consequence of the unscoped-crit call: stripping skill2's crit buffs must reduce the RIDER damage sum, not only normal-attack damage. This is the assertion that actually pays off the critRatePct-vs-critRateNormalPct distinction — under the scoped encoding the rider sum would be unchanged.

fixtures: controlComp('soline', true) only — a single deterministic 180s control comp (liter B1 / crown B2 / soline B3 carry / helm fixed B3, boss Fire, focus soline). soline is Burst III: a lone B3 makes ZERO full bursts, so B1+B2 are mandatory for her burst block to ever fire; the burst-rider assertions would be vacuous otherwise. The fixed B3 (helm) is KEPT rather than passed false: helm's crit line is the SCOPED critRateNormalPct, a distinct StatKey from soline's unscoped critRatePct, so it cannot confound any filter (and every buff assertion additionally filters on targetSlug === 'soline' + casterIdx === soline's slot). Counterfactuals are in-memory withPatchedOverride clones on the same fixture, so each pair differs by exactly one modeled fact. 7 runComp invocations total (1 base + 6 counterfactuals), well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: NONE it.skip'd — every kit line is expressible with existing primitives (hitCount trigger, attackSpeedPct/critRatePct/critDamagePct buffs, burstCast flatDamage). No ⛑ fields were needed: the kit states every magnitude, duration and threshold literally, and no line requires a cadence tuple, an invented trigger, a weapon swap, a stack steady-state, a multi-projectile split, a per-kit noFb, or a Hit-Rate→core magnitude.

CONDITION-AS-TRIVIAL (documented, not skipped): both 'at Max HP' clauses (skill2 gate + the burst 924% branch) are trivially TRUE at scope lock because v1 models no HP pool and the boss deals no damage. The tests therefore assert the buffs/hit are LIVE. If an HP pool is ever modeled, these become real gates and the assertions must be revisited — the faithful model would then need an explicit max-HP condition that this fixture cannot exercise (no way to drop soline below Max HP).
